lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Highly distinct, circular high-luminance pixel clusters arranged in multiple roughly horizontal rows posterior to the branchial slits. The spots show a gradient in size, being smaller and more densely packed near the head and larger/more spaced towards the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated luminance create a grid-like intersection with the horizontal rows of blobs, particularly prominent in the mid-section of the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp transition from high-intensity highlights on the dorsal side to low-intensity shadow on the ventral side of each ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple remoras (Echeneidae) are visible in the ventral area immediately posterior and inferior to the pectoral fin.
